did: Built the phone half of rendered assets. An episode's files beside its video (the video, its thumbnail and its chapters) are now one family. The episode page shows the thumbnail to save and the chapters to copy. Where home has no thumbnail, Generate asks home to make just that file, and its progress shows on the same conveyor Studio's renders use, moving on its own every half minute while it is under way. For home's worker I added a command that draws a thumbnail from an episode's folder without touching the video. It writes only to the folder home hands it, never overwrites, leaves no half file, gives the same bytes each time, and marks a refusal that would always repeat with one line, so home holds that ask instead of retrying it. The server half (REDO-S, server#1140) and the route snapshot merged, and the contracts for the two new routes followed in their own pull request.

calls.title: An episode's rendered files are one family of three, not four
options: video, thumbnail and description, with chapters as the description's one file
four members, chapters apart from the description
a thumbnail route, button and job of its own
calls.why: Home keeps chapters as the description file, so a fourth member would name a file that doesn't exist; and a thumbnail-only path would be one more copy of what the family already does.
calls.undo: Split chapters out as a member of its own in the asset union, or revert C1300.

calls.title: A file asked of home rides the renders conveyor, less its boxing station
options: the renders conveyor's stations less Boxing, read from home's step
the whole render line, Boxing included
a plain line of text per state, with no strip
calls.why: You asked for the same conveyor as Studio's takes and renders; a thumbnail is made in one go, so there are no scenes to box.
calls.undo: Revert C1301: draw the step as text, or add Boxing back to the file's stations.

left: The page can show Generate again for one list read when a drag down was already in flight as Generate was tapped: rare, and it corrects itself on the next read.
Playoff Delta's episode key is parsed in two places, the phone's episode words and the thumbnail command, because the command runs outside the app's path aliases.
